rows: Rout every enemy unit or capture the enemy HQ
Infantry/Mech: 20 capture points, minus the unit's HP per turn
Units on own cities/bases/ports/airports heal 2 HP per day (costs funds)
Meter fills from damage dealt and taken; press when full

widgets.text:
Attack first: damage scales with the attacker's HP, so a full-HP strike cripples the reply. Terrain stars cut damage taken (mountains 4, cities 3, woods 2). Use indirect units behind a line of tanks; block chokepoints with cheap infantry. Fog of War: Recon and mountains see further.
CO notes: Andy repairs, Max has strong direct units, Sami captures fast, Grit has long-range artillery, Olaf brings snow, Kanbei's units are tough and costly, Sonja hides HP in fog, Eagle's air units refuel cheaply and Lightning Strike gives a second move, Drake rules the sea, Sturm is the final enemy.

Field Training teaches the basics (Nell), then the Orange Star campaign leads through fights against Blue Moon (Olaf, Grit), Yellow Comet (Kanbei, Sonja), Green Earth (Eagle, Drake) and the final battle with Sturm. Some maps branch depending on the CO you pick (Andy/Max/Sami). Advance Campaign (hard) unlocks after clearing it.
Coins earned from campaign ranks and War Room buy new maps and COs in the Battle Maps shop. Design Maps lets you build your own maps.
Each victory is scored out of 300: Speed (days taken), Power (damage per attack) and Technique (units lost). 280+ is an S rank. War Room maps keep a high score per CO.
